podcast.title: Catalyst for Indie Music's Return
podcast.body: The Garage Rock Revival, which emerged in the very late 1990s, served as the fundamental catalyst for the broader indie music revival of the 2000s. This scene contributed significantly to getting rock music back into the public spotlight. "The underlying catalyst for the overall indie revival of the odds was another smaller scene, the Garage Rock Revival, that began in the very late 1990s."
